en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a wide street scene in Nijmegen, lined with ornate European-style buildings. The image captures people walking and a horse-drawn cart. A prominent building on the right displays the sign 'PEEK & CLOPPENBURG.' In the distance, a large church or cathedral with a tall spire is visible. The bottom of the postcard includes printed text with the city name 'Nijmegen,' the street name 'Lange Burchtstraat,' and a publisher's note. There is also a handwritten greeting.
